changelog:
• Gravity Sensing Freeze Fix: Eliminated blocking Thread.sleep() calls on UI thread during stop/reset packets
• Speedometer Zero Deadzone: Fixed accelerometer noise baseline calculation that previously locked gauge at 21 when level
• Throttled Sensor Dispatch: Sensor events optimized to UI delay rate (~60ms) and guarded animation restarts to ensure silky-smooth 60fps operation
• Responsive Steering: Re-linked AlbumOrientationEventListener for seamless tilt and steering control
